description: This file defines a Flutter widget called AppShell that provides a basic application layout with an AppBar and a body area, intended for quick startup of admin panel screens. It includes TODO comments for future enhancements like navigation drawer and top actions.

classes.name: AppShell
classes.description: A stateless widget that renders a scaffold with a customizable app bar and body content, designed for quick startup screens in an admin panel.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns the widget tree for the AppShell, including the app bar and body content.
